meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 BGPT MCP 服务器检索科学论文,返回从全文提取的结构化数据:每篇含方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25 个以上字段,而非只有标题和摘要。需先在 MCP 设置中配置 BGPT 服务器。
howto.when: 当你检索带具体实验细节的论文、做系统或范围综述,或要找定量结果、样本量等摘要里没有的信息时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: Claude searches papers via the BGPT MCP server and returns structured data from full texts: 25+ fields per paper, including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Configure the BGPT server in MCP settings first.
howto.when_en: Use it when searching papers for specific experimental details, running systematic or scoping reviews, or finding quantitative results, sample sizes, and effect sizes.
